title: Rebecca Jackson
clean_html:
Rebecca Jackson

Preserved Primary Document • jacksonr.htm

Rebecca Jackson was the daughter of Wesley Jackson and his wife, Elizabeth. She was born in 1861 probably in Northwest Fork Hundred, Sussex Co., DE. and appears with her family in the 1870 DE. census records. She died in Sussex Co., DE in 1944.

Rebecca married Levin T. HARMON , the son of Isaac Harmon and Sarah Sockum. Levin was born in Sussex Co., DE in 1860 and died there in 1940.
